title: A Matched-Protocol Benchmark Program for Context Selection in Agentic LLM Systems: harness and artifacts
description: Extracted public benchmark harness and released run artifacts for the matched-protocol context-selection benchmark program described in the accompanying paper (arXiv preprint forthcoming, cs.CL). The archive contains: a source snapshot of the public harness (arm contract, suites, official scorers, and the four latency measurement classes); the paper PDF; and a mixed-license data deposit assembled by tools/build_deposit.py spanning the released runs (RULER family, AppWorld family, and the control suites) under a strict per-item field allowlist with prompts, gate-internal signals, and dataset canaries excluded by construction. Every run ships a SHA-256 manifest. Code is licensed Apache-2.0; result data CC BY 4.0; upstream datasets are fetched by scripts and not redistributed here and remain under their own licenses.
